headline: M&T CFO says AI agents are coming in every day, but not much money is being moved
body: On a question from Gerard Cassidy about AI agents moving deposits around, M&T CFO Daryl Bible said agents are coming in every day. He added that the bank is not really seeing much impact of money being moved out yet, and that it is monitoring that very closely.
note: Bible says it is going to come down to trust, and that it will take time for people to get comfortable. For a deposit franchise, customer comfort with agents is the signal to watch.

evidence.text: Gerard Cassidy: Good. I got a bigger picture question for you.
There has been a lot of talk lately about the agentic AI agents coming in and maybe moving deposits around on the consumer deposit accounts
If you look at our center that we have now, agents are coming in every day.
We are not really seeing much impact of actually money being moved out or anything yet.
And we are monitoring that very closely.
I think it is going to come down to trust
it is going to take time for people to get comfortable with that
Senior Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer - Daryl Bible
